test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution: The correct answer is **'fix'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**fix**'. • Here, **'in a fix' **is a phrase. It means **'In a difficult or embarrassing situation, in a dilemma'.** (मुश्किल या शर्मनाक स्थिति में, दुविधा में) • *Example: I was really **in a fix **when I missed the plane.* Correct Paragraph:__ *Namita did not have enough cash. She did not __have__ a credit card either. She found herself in a __**fix**__. She had the contact number of a (3) ______ friend whom she called for help. Her friend came (4) ______ and settled the bill. Namita thanked her and expressed her (5) _______ . She promised to return the money to her friend soon.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Puzzle**: something that is difficult to understand or explain; a mystery. (जिसे समझना कठिन हो; गूढ़ बात, रहस्‍य) • **Pressure**: the force that is produced when you press on or against something. [(किसी वस्‍तु को) दबाने या धकेलने से उत्‍पन्‍न शक्ति; दबाव] • **Trouble**: (a situation that causes) a problem, difficulty, or worry. [समस्‍या, कठिनाई या चिंता (उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाली स्थिति)] 48:Ta0f, The correct answer is '**close**'.
